defs.def: to officially tell sb that you are leaving your job, an organization, etc. 辞职；辞去（某职务）

ex.s: Dr Rowan, ______ secretary resigned two weeks ago, has had to do all his own typing. （    ）
ex.t: 罗恩博士，____秘书两周前辞职了，不得不自己打所有字。（    ）

ex.s: We should live with them in harmony and enjoy nature’s gifts, as he describes in his journals: Live in each season as it passes; breathe the air, drink the drink, taste the fruit, and resign yourself to the influences of each.
ex.t: 我们应该与它们和谐相处，享受大自然的馈赠，正如他在日记中描述的那样：在每一个季节中生活；呼吸空气，品尝饮品，品味果实，顺从每一个季节的影响。

ex.s: Live in each season as it passes; breathe the air, drink the drink, taste the fruit, and resign yourself to the influences of each.
ex.t: 活在逝去的每一个季节里；呼吸空气，饮那饮品，尝那果实，顺从各自的感召。

ex.s: Eventually he resigned his post in the UK and returned to China to work at Jilin University in Changchun.
ex.t: 最终他辞去了在英国的工作，回到中国在长春的吉林大学工作。
